unchanged: appointment rule, coordinates, service, terrain, threats, clearance, climb/turn, Fitness, PSO and uniform rand initialization
choiceRule: Highest feasible rate, then mean feasible objective, then lower FE/population. If all configs fail, do not promote a new default; report failure and use most generous tested config only as explicitly labelled diagnostic for held-out scale check.

holdout.execution: three MATLAB workers split by N to shorten wall-clock; each run unchanged FE/rand. Holdout raw seconds are concurrent measurements, not comparable runtime ranking.
holdout.exclusionReason: Exact DP and independent Python DP prove no feasible time ordering even in the optimistic direct-XYZ relaxation, including an infeasible required14-station subset. Exclusion based on problem feasibility, not algorithm outcome.

pairedPopulation: one max60-by-D rand matrix per seed, P30 first30 rows, same positions across FE budgets
counts: all initial and candidate Fitness calls count in FE; verification excluded
